dashboard.title: 📊 Stock Analysis Dashboard - IHSG & Prediksi
dashboard.description: Dashboard analisis pergerakan IHSG, clustering saham, dan prediksi harga. Tujuan: mengidentifikasi kapan IHSG menyentuh 6000 dan melihat potensi market.

panels.title: IHSG Close Price (7d & 30d SMA)

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ihsg" and r._field == "close")

panels.description: Menampilkan harga penutupan IHSG dengan 7-day dan 30-day Simple Moving Average untuk melihat tren jangka pendek dan panjang.

panels.title: IHSG Volume Perdagangan

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ihsg" and r._field == "volume")

panels.description: Volume perdagangan IHSG harian. Volume tinggi mengindikasikan minat pasar yang kuat.

panels.title: Volatilitas IHSG (5d Rolling)

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ihsg" and r._field == "volatility")

panels.description: Volatilitas 5-hari IHSG. Volatilitas tinggi menandakan ketidakpastian pasar.

panels.title: Cluster Distribution (KMeans)

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cluster" and r._field == "count")

panels.description: Distribusi cluster hasil KMeans clustering. Cluster menunjukkan kelompok saham dengan karakteristik相似 (risk, return, volatility).

panels.title: RSI (Relative Strength Index) - IHSG

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ihsg" and r._field == "rsi")

panels.description: RSI 14-hari IHSG. RSI > 70 = overbought (jenuh beli), RSI < 30 = oversold (jenuh jual).

panels.title: Prediksi IHSG: Hari ke 6000

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction" and r._field == "days_to_6000") |> last()

panels.description: Estimasi jumlah hari sampai IHSG menyentuh 6000 berdasarkan tren pergerakan saat ini.

panels.title: Daily Change % - Semua Saham

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stocks" and r._field == "daily_change_pct")

panels.description: Perubahan harga harian untuk setiap saham. Warna hijau = naik, merah = turun.

panels.title: Saham per Cluster (Scatter)

targets.query: from(bucket: "stock-metrics") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stocks") |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")

panels.description: Scatter plot saham berdasarkan return dan volatility, diwarnai berdasarkan cluster.
